gizmo.title: Inothi yaphansi
gizmo.description: Inothi elibhalwe lapho elifanele khona embhalweni. Liboniswa njengenombolo, futhi uhlu lwamanothi olunezinombolo luzakhela lona ngezansi kwekhasi.

configure.title: Akukho ukubuka kuqala
configure.description: Ungalibonisi inothi uma umfundi ezulazula noma egxila enombolweni.
